x: 2. · Polytechnic H. (position of 4th man 15th), A. W. Peck · 18m. 44s.

It had been originally decided to hold the handicap over a 5-miles course on December 20th, but owing to weather conditions it had to be postponed, so it was decided to hold it in conjunction with this race, and 18 Belgrave and 4 Polytechnic members supported the event. Second place in the handicap was taken by A.
